classification.difficultyReason: Match a positive coefficient of modest strength to the options by comparing both trend direction and scatter.

content.prompt: Which graph best shows data with a correlation closest to $0.3$?

spec.description: Four horizontally arranged options (A)–(D). Each has arrowed axes, an origin label 0, ticks labelled 50 on both axes, no variable names and no grid. Nine points in each option are reconstructed from the source positions.
spec.mathematics: A has a dispersed positive pattern, B a dispersed negative pattern, C a clearer negative pattern and D a clearer positive pattern. Coordinates reproduce visual positions rather than asserting an original numerical dataset.
spec.answerVisibility: All option plots are student-visible; no supplied answer letter is printed beside them.

answer.worked: $r=0.3$ indicates a weak positive correlation. Graph A shows an upward trend with more scatter than graph D. Graphs B and C show negative trends. Correct answer: A.
